results.name: Firmware/software configuration
results.criterion: expected: 2 gens, 3 readouts, tProc v2 core 200 MHz / time 491.52 MHz, 8 pins

results.name: Memory access: host and tProc
results.criterion: host load/read 512 random words; tProc counted loop writing 64 register-addressed words. NB: QICK's own load_mem readback check is broken for addr != 0 (upstream software bug, worked around)

results.name: Wiring matrix (gen -> readout)
results.criterion: gen0->ro0 must be wired; others reported (peak/median > 50 = wired)

results.name: Single const pulse: width, timing shift, repeatability
results.criterion: width 0.4 us and a 0.1 us shift within 3/2 samples; 5 runs: amplitude CV < 1%, phase sd < 1 deg

results.name: Envelope shapes: gauss, flat_top, triangle, DRAG, custom
results.criterion: measured |envelope| vs the program's own envelope samples (best shift+scale): normalised RMS residual < 3% each

results.name: Gain sweep (QickSweep1D): linearity
results.criterion: |IQ| vs actual gain: max deviation from a line < 1% FS, intercept < 1% FS, phase constant < 1 deg

results.name: Phase sweep: commanded vs measured
results.criterion: 12 phases 0..330: |error| < 1 deg each, amplitude CV < 0.5%

results.name: Frequency matching: phase coherence across runs
results.criterion: 10 separately compiled runs at an odd frequency: phase sd < 1 deg

results.name: Dynamic readout frequency sweep (exec_before) + electrical delay
results.criterion: 3601 points 100-1900 MHz, twice: linear phase (residual RMS < 5 deg), delay repeatable to 0.1 ns, no dropouts

results.name: Timeline semantics: delay, delay_auto, wait, collisions, swept delay
results.criterion: pulse separations within 3 samples (5.4 ns) of the documented timeline

wait.note: b must start no earlier than wait time - a start (0.7 us)

results.name: 2D sweep (QickSpan), loop order, reps_innermost
results.criterion: |IQ| proportional to the 3x4 QickSpan gain grid within 2%; per-shot raw data ordered as declared

results.name: Accumulated vs decimated buffer, per shot, exact
results.criterion: sum of each shot's decimated samples == that shot's accumulated value, all shots

results.name: Feedback: read_input == buffered accumulation, per shot (sweep read_wait)
results.criterion: with a sufficient read_wait, the tProc's read_input equals the buffer's per-shot sum (I and Q) on every shot

results.name: Conditional pulse (read_and_jump) decision consistency
results.criterion: the conditional pulse plays exactly on the shots whose first readout has I < 0 (same-shot raw value)

results.name: Virtual-Z via read/write_wmem subroutine; subroutine timing; per-pulse gain
results.criterion: phases 0/90/90/180 within 2 deg on both reps (reset works); subroutine pulse starts within 3 samples; gain ratios 1/0.5/0.25 within 1%

results.name: tProc ALU, ARITH, DIV and conditional-jump tests
results.criterion: every result written to dmem equals Python's (32-bit)

results.name: DDR4 buffer: capture, shot period (final_delay), equality with decimated buffer
results.criterion: every shot's pulse in DDR4 at a constant period (> final_delay); a shot's decimated samples found bit-exactly in the DDR4 stream

results.name: MR buffer: raw ADC capture, tone frequency
results.criterion: MR data valid: two quadrature columns at fs/2 = 2211.84 Msps with the tone at 300 MHz. QICK's soccfg text (8192 samples = 1.852 us) and get_time_axis_mr() assume fs = 4423.68 Msps, so a user following the tutorial sees the tone at 2x. Documentation/software mismatch, not our change

results.name: Edge counter vs software Schmitt trigger
results.criterion: hardware edge count == number of pulses == software Schmitt count on the decimated I trace

results.name: Untestable on this wiring: gen 1, readouts 1/2 (weighted buffer), time tagger, PMOD pins
results.criterion: connect a loopback (e.g. gen 1 -> readout 1) to cover these

results.name: Readout-chain integrity: CW tone in the decimated buffer, phase-continuity glitch search
results.criterion: 8 x 16k consecutive samples of a detuned CW tone through the readout chain: no phase jump > 10 sd, no dropout, rotation = detuning

results.name: DDR4 stream continuity: CW tone through DDR4
results.criterion: ~12 M consecutive DDR4 samples: no discontinuity. A failure with jumps that each skip ~16 samples at 16-aligned positions means the DDR4 write path drops whole 16-sample beats

results.name: Program size and timing limits
results.criterion: a ~1000-pulse program fits program memory and every pulse is played
